claims.assertion: Athena alleges Greer is a CIA asset using staged opposition to boost credibility; she defines negative priming as appearing opposed while cooperating with an alleged opponent.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says Greer helps prepare a false alien-invasion narrative by normalizing extraterrestrials; she rejects the claim that all extraterrestrials are benevolent.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says the plan’s eventual form is unknown.

claims.assertion: Athena says her group’s own public contact may also support the false-invasion plan, while cautioning that they lack all the pieces.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
